subject: Life Insurance Inquiry
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

My name is Maria García López and I am writing to inquire about your life insurance products. I recently moved to Germany and I am looking for comprehensive coverage for myself and potentially my family in the future.

I currently live at Calle Gran Vía 28, 3º Izquierda, 28013 Madrid, Spain, though I am in the process of relocating. I have been working as a software developer at MadridSoft for the past 3 years.

Could you please send me information about your term life insurance options? I am particularly interested in policies that offer good value for someone in their late 30s.

You can reach me at this email address or by phone at +34 612 345 678.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Maria García López
